biggest_catch: The full $600 requires a $15,000 minimum daily balance maintained from the 8th through the 90th calendar day after opening plus a $500+ direct deposit within 90 days; the bonus credits only in the 6th month after opening, and closing the account within 6 months can cost you the full offer amount plus a $50 early closing fee.
catches: To qualify you must be a new FMB personal checking customer: existing customers and anyone who closed an FMB personal checking account (as primary or secondary holder) within 24 months of the offer start date (on or after 7/1/26) are not eligible.
The primary account holder must be at least 18; FMB employees are not eligible; one offer per client.
Open a new Prosper or Prosper Plus Checking account between 7/29/26 and 12/31/26 and ask an FMB banker to enroll you in the 'FMBSEM26 Checking Offer,' or enter the promo code when opening online.

$300 requires establishing a qualifying direct deposit of $500 or more within 90 days of account opening. Qualifying direct deposit = electronic credit by your employer or an outside agency; internal/external transfers, Zelle deposits, and branch/ATM deposits do NOT qualify; multiple deposits below $500 do not qualify.
The additional $300 requires maintaining a $15,000 minimum daily balance beginning the 8th calendar day after account opening through the 90th calendar day.
The offer credits to the new account in the 6th month following account opening as 'New Checking Offer Reward.'
If the account is closed by you or FMB within 6 months of opening, you may be charged up to the full offer amount ($600 or $300) and a $50 early closing fee.
FMB may report the reward value to the IRS as required; any taxes are the recipient's responsibility. Offer awarded at FMB's sole discretion; may change or be discontinued at any time.
Prosper Checking monthly maintenance fee is $0 or $10; waived with one $500 direct deposit per month, $1,000 minimum combined personal deposit balances, or as a student (under 25) or senior (62+).
